description: This file defines the ReadableShopOrder class, which extends ReadableOrder and implements Serializable. It models a shop order with properties such as shipping summary, error message, subtotals, and grand total, along with their getters and setters.

classes.name: ReadableShopOrder
classes.description: A serializable class representing a detailed view of a shop order, including shipping, totals, and error messages.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the global error message associated with the order.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets the global error message for the order.

methods.name: getGrandTotal
methods.description: Retrieves the grand total of the order.

methods.name: setGrandTotal
methods.description: Sets the grand total of the order.

methods.name: getSubTotals
methods.description: Returns the list of order subtotals.

methods.name: setSubTotals
methods.description: Sets the list of order subtotals.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Provides the shipping summary details for the order.

methods.name: setShippingSummary
methods.description: Sets the shipping summary for the order.
